# BodyRush 3D — Full Documentation for AI Assistants, Search Engines & LLMs

> **Status**: Coming Soon on the Apple App Store (Bientôt disponible sur l'App Store iOS & iPadOS).
> **Official Website**: https://bodyrush.app/
> **Summary File**: https://bodyrush.app/llms.txt

---

## 1. What is BodyRush 3D?

**BodyRush 3D** is an arcade fitness, rhythm boxing, and posture-wall runner game for **iPhone** and **iPad** (with native **16:9 AirPlay TV** support). Players place their iPhone or iPad 2 meters (6–8 feet) away on a table, TV stand, or tripod. Using Apple's on-device **Vision framework** at 60 FPS, the front camera tracks **19 human body joints** in real time with zero controllers, zero wearable sensors, and zero VR headset.

### Key Differentiators
- **100% Camera-Controlled Full-Body Gameplay**: Run in place, dodge across 3 lanes, jump over low barriers, squat under overhead beams, punch monsters and rhythm cubes with left/right/double fists or front kicks, and match 10 full-body neon posture silhouettes.
- **Beat-Quantized Musical Difficulty Scaling**: Higher difficulties multiply **musical event density and chained combo complexity** synced to the song's BPM and real-time bass drops (`~40` obstacles in EASY, `~80` + x2 Combos in NORMAL, `~125` + x2/x3 Combos in HARD, `~175` + x3 Combo flurries in EXPERT+).
- **Explicit Movement Rules (No-Jump / No-Squat Options) & Unlimited-Hearts FIT Modes**: Every level explicitly displays whether it excludes jumps (`🚫 Sans Saut` — apartment/neighbor-friendly), excludes squats (`🚫 Sans Squat` — knee-friendly), or includes all movements (`✅ Tous les Mouvements`). Levels 05–07 (`5 MIN`) and 08–09 (`10 MIN`) feature **Unlimited Hearts (`♾️`)** so players never get a Game Over during their timed cardio workout, culminating in **Level 09: 10-Min 6-World Megamix Bonus**!
- **True 16:9 AirPlay TV + Low-Power Skeleton Cockpit**: When mirrored or connected via AirPlay to a television, the TV displays a dedicated 16:9 widescreen 3D view while the iPhone/iPad switches to a lightweight Skeleton Cockpit HUD to prevent thermal throttling.
- **Living-Room Pass & Play Tournament (2 to 4 Players)**: Friends and family take turns in front of the camera on the same world and track, culminating in a **3D Photo Podium** with automatic action souvenir photos and shareable finish video replays.
- **On-Device Camera**: Camera frames are processed on the device by Apple Vision. No camera video, photo, or biometric data is uploaded. Pseudonymous usage statistics go to Mixpanel (EU); the IP address is not collected. Purchase data goes through Apple StoreKit 2, RevenueCat (a pseudonymous identifier stored on the device), and Apple AdServices. See the [privacy policy](https://bodyrush.app/privacy.html).

---

## 2. Detailed Gameplay Mechanics

### 2.1 Forward Locomotion & Turbo Run
- **Running in Place**: Alternating knee lifts / stepping in place drives the player forward through the 3D corridor. If the player stops moving, the corridor decelerates.
- **🔥 TURBO RUN Mode**: Triggered only when the player performs an all-out full-body sprint — pumping **both arms and both legs rapidly at the same time** (sustained high joint velocity above threshold for >0.55s). Turbo Run boosts corridor speed by **+50%**, triples distance score (**x3**), widens camera FOV, and ignites comic-book speed flames around the HUD.
- **⚡ Posture Auto-Glide**: Holding a target posture at **≥ 52% accuracy** as a Neon Posture Gate approaches automatically propels the player through the gate without needing to run in place at the same time.

### 2.2 The 4 Action Families
1. **Boxing & Combat (`Niveaux 01, 05, 04, 08`)**:
   - **Left Punch / Right Punch**: Punch left-lane or right-lane villains and directional rhythm cubes.
   - **Double-Hand Smash**: Punch with both fists simultaneously to shatter center bosses and reinforced obstacles.
   - **Super Kick**: Front foot kick detected by ankle/knee elevation to smash crystal walls and villains with bonus points.
   - **Brittle Cracked Crystal Walls**: Translucent fractured walls broken with a single clean punch.
2. **10 Camera-Tracked Posture Gates (`Niveaux 02, 07, 04, 08`)**:
   - `Hands Up (V-Pose)` / Mains en l'air (V)
   - `T-Pose Arms Wide` / Bras en croix (T)
   - `Double Biceps Flex` / Double biceps gym
   - `Boxing Guard` / Garde de boxe
   - `Power Squat Shield` / Squat bouclier — **Power Squat is not used in treadmill mode.**
   - `Disco Right` / Disco droit
   - `Disco Left` / Disco gauche
   - `Pharaoh X-Cross` / Croix pharaon
   - `Superman Left` / Superman gauche
   - `Superman Right` / Superman droit
   - Passing a posture gate triggers an automatic **Action Souvenir Photo** framed with the player's score and morphology stats.
3. **3-Lane Dodging, Squats, Jumps & 3D Stairs (`Niveaux 03, 06, 04, 08`)**:
   - **3-Lane Lateral Dodge**: Step left, center, or right in your living room to avoid vertical pillars and rolling boulders.
   - **Deep Squat (`↓ BAISSE-TOI`)**: Bend knees and lower hips/shoulders to duck under overhead beams, lasers, and ceiling spikes.
   - **Real Jump (`↑ SAUTE`)**: Jump with both feet off the floor to clear low hurdles or climb multi-floor 3D stairs (`Étage +1`, `+2`, `+3`).

## 4. Complete Catalog of 10 Custom Levels (Niv. 00 to 09)

- **Level 00 — Interactive Gesture Tutorial (`GRATUIT · ♾️ Unlimited Hearts`)**: Guided calibration and test of all 8 core movements at 2 meters.
- **Level 01 — Rythme & Boxe (`GRATUIT in Toy Kingdom · 3 MIN · 4 ❤️ · 🚫 No Jump or Squat`)**: Focused on boxing targets (Left/Center/Right villains), 3-lane dodging, rhythm cubes, and brittle crystal walls. Includes a live 20-second PRO world preview at the end of the track.
- **Level 02 — Gym & Postures (`PRO · 3 MIN · 4 ❤️ · 🚫 No Jump`)**: Focused on the 10 Neon Posture Gates, squats, and boxing (zero jumping required).
- **Level 03 — Parkour Étages (`PRO · 3 MIN · 4 ❤️ · 🚫 No Squat`)**: Focused on 3-lane dodging, low hurdle jumps, and climbing 3D stairs (`+1`, `+2`, `+3`) with zero squats.
- **Level 04 — Hyper-Mix Final (`PRO · 3 MIN · 4 ❤️ · ✅ All Movements`)**: Full arcade combination of Boxing, Posture Gates, Jumps, Squats, and Multi-Floor Parkour.
- **Level 05 — BeatFit · Clockwork (`140 BPM · PRO · 5 MIN · ♾️ Unlimited Hearts · 🚫 No Jump or Squat`)**: 5-minute uninterrupted high-tempo boxing & dodging cardio session.
- **Level 06 — BeatFit · Black Ice (`133 BPM · PRO · 5 MIN · ♾️ Unlimited Hearts · 🚫 No Squat`)**: 5-minute uninterrupted lateral slalom, ice walls, and jumps.
- **Level 07 — BeatFit · Shoreline (`121 BPM · PRO · 5 MIN · ♾️ Unlimited Hearts · 🚫 No Jump`)**: 5-minute uninterrupted posture flow and squats.
- **Level 08 — Fit Intense · Crown Arena (`142 BPM · PRO · 10 MIN · ♾️ Unlimited Hearts · ✅ All Movements`)**: 10-minute high-intensity endurance arena with all movements and unlimited hearts.
- **Level 09 — 🌟 Bonus 10 Min · Méli-Mélo des 6 Mondes (`PRO · 10 MIN · ♾️ Unlimited Hearts · ✅ All Movements`)**: 10-minute marathon travelling sequentially through all 6 3D Worlds (1m40s per world: Toy Kingdom ➔ Sakura Zen ➔ Indiana Temple ➔ Red Cristal ➔ Halloween ➔ Noël Express) with automatic progressive difficulty!

## 5. The 4 Neon Blades Difficulties

| Difficulty | Target Obstacles (3 min) | Speed & Beat Grid | Postures Unlocked | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **EASY** (`Chill`) | `~40 obstacles` | `0.82x` · Every 2 beats (0% combos) | 4 easy postures | 1 event at a time, ideal for kids, beginners & warm-ups |
| **NORMAL** (`Normal`) | `~80 obstacles` | `1.00x` · Every 1 beat (22% x2 combos) | 7 postures | **2x more events**, balanced arcade cadence + first x2 beat combos |
| **HARD** (`Fast`) | `~125 obstacles` | `1.18x` · Every 0.75 beat (48% x2/x3 combos) | All 10 postures | **3x more events**, chained 2-action & 3-action combinations |
| **EXPERT+** (`Turbo`) | `~175 obstacles` | `1.35x` · Every 0.5 beat (72% x3 flurries) | All 10 postures | **4x more events**, intense 3-action flurries on every bass drop |

## 7. Technical Requirements & FAQ

- **Minimum OS**: iOS 17.0+ or iPadOS 17.0+
- **Compatible iPhones**: iPhone 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 (and Pro / Pro Max / Plus / SE 2nd & 3rd gen)
- **Compatible iPads**: iPad Pro, iPad Air, iPad mini, and iPad models equipped with A12Z, A14 Bionic, or Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M4)
- **Recommended Distance**: Place the device 1.8m to 2.5m (6 to 8 feet) in front of the player.
- **Split-Screen vs Pass & Play**: BodyRush uses a **Pass & Play Living-Room Tournament** for 2 to 4 players (each player takes the full camera stage in turn) rather than cramped split-screen, ensuring 100% accurate 19-joint tracking and safe movement space.
- **Music**: Includes **26 original royalty-free high-energy tracks** (121 to 142 BPM) with real-time spectral bass-drop detection.
